author: Nollaig O'Connor
description: Even after more than 100 passengers and crewmembers fell sick during a norovirus outbreak aboard the Caribbean Princess cruise ship, passenger Jan van Milligen said life on board still felt surprisingly normal.“The normal atmosphere is still here,” van Milligen, who has spent the last 21 days aboard the ship with relatives and friends from South Africa, told NBC News on Saturday.
title: More than 100 sickened in norovirus outbreak aboard Caribbean Princess cruise

description: A Frontier Airlines plane had to abort its takeoff after hitting a person on the runway at Denver International Airport. The airline says all 224 passengers and seven crew members evacuated safely from the plane. The airport says the emergency response is ongoing and the runway where the pedestrian was struck will remain closed as the investigation continues. NBC’s Valerie Castro reports for Saturday TODAY.
title: Frontier Plane Aborts Takeoff After Hitting a Person on the Runway
